articles.title: Engine-Turn Starburst
articles.summary: Radial burst of bright fly-cut arcs on polished billet, sharp leading crescents, micro-anisotropic streaks. A soft grainy sheen; blotches blend into a slightly cloudy texture in the highlights.
articles.what: Explosive radial-arc cluster — 30-50 radiation points each emitting 8-14 fly-cut arcs fanning 12-22 px with bright leading-edge crescents on polished billet steel + 6-10 Up close: A soft, mottled fine grain like orange peel or a fine sponge, blotches about 6-10 px with no hard edges, visible all through the highlight on both halves and slightly stronger on metallic. No starbursts, arcs or crescents can be seen. From a distance: A soft grainy sheen; blotches blend into a slightly cloudy texture in the highlights. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Engine-Turn & Machined (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
when: Best on: hood, roof, hero panel.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Legacy collection tab and the group "Engine-Turn & Machined", or search for "Engine-Turn Starburst".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof and doors on metallic bases
Large panels where a gentle grain is wanted
Numbers stay readable; the grain is soft.
A mild orange-peel style grain in the highlight
Pairs well with: gloss, metallic, chrome.
pitfalls: Not an engine-turn starburst: the render shows soft grain, no radial arcs or crescents
Not an airbrush gradient paint: it adds no colour fade
Avoid: matte base kills the arcs, avoid over fine stripes.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Engine-Turn Starburst over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
